stem:
The distance in miles that some students live from school is shown in the histogram.

Which statement about the data in the histogram is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The distribution of the data is asymmetrical, so the mean and the median are likely outside the "2.1-3 mile" category.

options.label: B
options.text: The distribution of the data is asymmetrical, so the mean and the median are likely within the "2.1-3 mile" category.

options.label: C
options.text: The distribution of the data is symmetrical, so the mean and the median are likely outside the "2.1-3 mile" category.

options.label: D
options.text: The distribution of the data is symmetrical, so the mean and the median are likely within the "2.1-3 mile" category.

visual_elements: histogram showing Number of Students versus Distance (miles) with categories 0.1-1, 1.1-2, 2.1-3, 3.1-4, 4.1-5
